name: Crystal Clusters

features.name: Exploding clusters
features.description: Gem clusters explode and multipliers rise with each explosion.

review:
Glowing gems link up and explode on a cluster grid, and the multiplier rises with every explosion – so long chain reactions are what you're hoping for.

Each reel can hold one scatter. Three give 10 free spins, and more scatters give 12, 15, 20 or 30. In the bonus, multipliers lock in place, so later cascades benefit from everything that's built up before them. Very high volatility, a 5,000x max and 96.5% RTP. Free spins about once every 273 spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
